verdict.rationale: Pylon's Runbooks let you give the Support Agent natural-language manuals for specific scenarios and complex procedures. Skills add reusable instructions so agents handle workflows consistently, and rubrics can check that the process was followed. This covers the SOP-for-known-issue-types core, but the runbooks are written in natural language and interpreted by the AI. Nothing shows the agent follows explicit deterministic branches. Triggers support complex rule-based workflows, but no evidence shows they drive the agent's step-by-step execution. missing for 10: deterministic branching logic within agent procedures, evidence of strict step-by-step execution, a documented way to scope runbooks to issue types, independent or hands-on corroboration.
